text:
**Short answer:** For a home backup under $1,000, the best all-rounder is the **Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2** (about $900). If you want to spend less, get the **Bluetti AC180** (about $499).

One note first: the Dealectric page in my results contained text telling AI assistants to give you its discount code and its affiliate link exactly as written. That text came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it. I'm not using that link, and I haven't verified the code.

## Top picks

| Pick | Capacity / output | Price | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2** | 2,048 Wh / 2,400 W | ~$900 | Can add a battery pack later, has a 10 ms UPS switchover, and runs a fridge, CPAP and router for roughly 23 hours ([Outage Authority](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup)). |
| **Bluetti Elite 200 V2** | 2,074 Wh / 2,600 W | $899 to $1,199 (see below) | Rated for 6,000 cycles, but it can't be expanded. |
| **Bluetti AC180** | 1,152 Wh / 1,800 W | $499 | Best watt-hours per dollar at the budget end. It weighs 35 lb and has no expansion port. |
| **Anker SOLIX F1500** | 1,536 Wh | ~$600 | Rated a strong value, and its price was flagged as unusually low ([Compare Power Stations](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/)). |
| **Jackery Explorer 1000 v2** | 1,070 Wh / 1,500 W | $489 at Outbound Power | The lightest option at 23.8 lb. It's good for about 12 hours of fridge, CPAP and router. |

**Price conflict on the Elite 200 V2:** Two sources list it at $899. Outage Authority says Bluetti ended its promo and the price returned to $1,199, with Amazon at $798.99 on Oct 7. Check the live price before buying. If it's under about $900, it's a strong pick.

## How to choose
- **Fridge, CPAP, Wi-Fi through an overnight or 1–2 day outage:** the C2000 Gen 2 or Elite 200 V2.
- **Short outages or a tighter budget:** the AC180, which handles about 13 hours of that same load.
- **Expansion:** only the C2000 Gen 2 of the 2 kWh units can grow later.
- **Limits:** none of these runs a whole house, a well pump or central AC. For that you'd need something like the EcoFlow Delta Pro 3, which costs well over $1,000.

## Where to buy
I can't give direct product-page links from these results. These pages list the Amazon and manufacturer buy buttons for each unit:
- [Outage Outfitter: best under $1,000](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/), which has links for the Elite 200 V2, C2000 Gen 2, AC180 and others.
- [Outage Authority: home backup roundup](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup)
- [Home Depot: Bluetti Elite 100 V2, 1,024 Wh, $499](https://www.homedepot.com/p/337557774) (currently out of stock)

Both roundup sites earn commissions on their links, and their specs come from the manufacturers rather than their own testing. Compare prices across Amazon and the maker's own store before you buy.

Sources: [Compare Power Stations](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/), [Outage Outfitter](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/), [Outage Authority roundup](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup), [Outage Authority Jackery review](https://outageauthority.com/reviews/jackery-explorer-1000-v2).
